title: Orbital integral bounds the character for cuspidal representations of $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_{\ell}((t)))$
summary:
We prove that the character of an irreducible cuspidal representation of $GL_n(\mathbb{F}_{\ell}((t)))$ is locally bounded up to a logarithmic factor by the orbital integral of a matrix coefficient of this representation.
  The characteristic $0$ analog of this result is part of the proof of the celebrated Harish-Chandra's integrability theorem.
  In a sequel work [AGKS] we use this result in order to prove a positive characteristic analog of Harish-Chandra's integrability theorem under some additional assumptions.
